scientific_integrity: Original combinatorial proof and exact inclusion-exclusion and Stirling-number formulas. No independent mathematical audit or formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only two-token graphs of complete bipartite hosts with both part sizes at least two. The universal formula has a self-contained proof, with finite computational corroboration; it does not determine higher-token or arbitrary-host polynomials. Mathematical priority and the proof have not received independent review.
title: Total-domination polynomial of two-token complete-bipartite graphs
